_comment: Remove this _comment key before writing to production.
Structure: permissions.{ allow, ask, deny, defaultMode, additionalDirectories, ... }
Evaluation order: deny → ask → allow (deny always wins).
NEVER set defaultMode to bypassPermissions — it disables ALL safety checks.

permissions._comment_allow: Narrow allow rules per your project toolchain. Prefer specific patterns over bare 'Bash'.
permissions._comment_ask: Commands that should always require human confirmation. Good for destructive or network operations.
permissions._comment_deny: Always deny dangerous Bash + secret files. Deny wins over allow.
permissions._comment_defaultMode: Use 'default' (prompt once per session) or 'acceptEdits' (auto-accept file edits). Never 'bypassPermissions'.
permissions._comment_disable: Prevents the agent from activating bypassPermissions mode interactively.
